svg.title: Antirez idle scan: two synchronized universes
svg.desc: Animated IPv4 idle scan. The attacker sends identical packets in both worlds. Closed ports cause no extra zombie reset; open ports cause an extra zombie reset, consuming the IP ID missing from the attacker’s observations. Three ports are tested in a 78-second loop. Every packet carries colored source and destination IP dots. Spoofed SYNs have the zombie’s source IP.
svg.text: Same attacker packets. Two possible worlds.
Only the probe replies consume IDs.
An extra packet uses the number.
Never reply to a RST with a RST
Zombie: idle; one global IPv4 IP-ID counter; +1 for every outgoing packet.
